**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (fallback cure).**

- **What the document has:** Article XII's exit provisions (12.3(c)(iv)–(vi), p0512–p0524) impose transition assistance, know-how transfer, regulatory/data transfer, trademark assignment and inventory transfer **on Sanofi in RevMed's favour**. Section 12.3(e) (p0531) gives Sanofi limited assistance only in one Change-of-Control scenario. Section 11.6 (p0477) is mutual but provides for *destruction* of Confidential Information on request, with no return/export and no fixed period.
- **Why it fails fallback:** no RevMed-side obligation triggered by expiry or termination generally, no 90-day assistance period, no 30-day data export.
- **Cure:** one insert after p0531 adding Section 12.3(f) — reciprocal transition assistance of at least 90 days plus export of Sanofi's data within 30 days. Fallback target chosen deliberately; the preferred six-month/machine-readable/certified-deletion package was not volunteered, and the one-way Sanofi obligations were left untouched.
